quotes.quote: LIDstral Arabic is a fast language and dialect classifier for text written in Arabic script.
It identifies Modern Standard Arabic, all Arabic dialects, and non-Arabic languages that use the same script.
We include these non-Arabic languages in training to help the model distinguish languages that share a script and avoid classifying text as Arabic based on its script alone.
Mistral × MTNRA Collection
Models co-developed in partnership with Morocco
Per-label F1 on the Arabic benchmark
We evaluate on 84,870 Arabic examples drawn from various benchmarks including NADI, MADAR, QADI, Casablanca, FLEURS, SMOL, Omnilingual ASR, and Hassaniya.
On Moroccan Darija, LIDstral Arabic achieves 88.67% F1, compared with 72.65% for LahjatBERT ALDi CL, the strongest tested baseline for this dialect, and 71.28% for GlotLID v3.
The model combines a fastText one-vs-all (OVA) classifier, an MLP stacker, and per-class isotonic calibration:
A 64-unit LayerNorm MLP maps these scores to probabilities over the classes.
It uses 144 features derived from raw scores, prior corrections, confidence margins, entropy, and regional summaries.
classify.py runs the pipeline on CPU, including preprocessing and feature extraction.
Calibration can change both confidence and the predicted label.
Each input that remains nonempty after preprocessing receives a predicted label and calibrated probabilities over all 51 classes.
Preprocessing removes web and ASR artifacts, diacritics, decorative elongation, and repeated punctuation.
Empty inputs and text removed entirely by preprocessing raise an error.
Illustrative batch output, with selected probabilities shown for each input:
The model always assigns one of its 51 supported classes.
It may therefore misclassify unsupported languages or mixed-language text.
